description:
Twenty-year-old 'Ye-eun' dates handsome 'Jung-hyeon' and burns up her youth in her 20s

At the age of 30, he broke up with Jung-hyeon due to the reality of marriage.

Two years later, Ye-eun receives a wedding invitation from her co-worker 'Seon-mi' with Jeong-hyeon's name on it...

Should I blush alone in the same workplace?

Just when her loneliness grows bigger than she noticed, handsome men start appearing in front of Ye-eun one by one.

Ye-eun is confused between her ex-boyfriend's best friend 'Se-jin' and her younger brother 'Jin-han'. ...By the way, Junghyun still likes me?

What will Ye-eun's relationship look like when she starts over at the age of 32?
